fusions.name: Pack Takedown
fusions.desc: Leaps up to 6 tiles onto an enemy for 28 damage and strips 15% of its armour for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Brawling Tumble
fusions.desc: Tumbles into a scrap with everything around you, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Each use costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Strange Bedfellows
fusions.desc: Allies within 5 tiles deal 15% more damage and gain 1 Power for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Sworn Hound
fusions.desc: A hound fights beside you, biting enemies within 4.5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and slowing each by 20% for 2 seconds.
